summary: Third Coast Bancshares filed an 8-K disclosing an October 6, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Reorganization under which its Thunder Merger Sub will merge into Great Plains Bancshares, with Great Plains surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary, followed by a second-step merger into Third Coast and the merger of Great Plains National Bank into Third Coast Bank. A joint press release, investor slides and employee communications were furnished. Pricing, exchange ratio, premium and board recommendation are not stated in the excerpt; structural and regulatory details remain to be confirmed in the merger documents.
